allow: PowerShell($g = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "git: $\($g.Source\)"; git --version } else { "git: NAO ENCONTRADO" }; $h = Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($h\) { "gh: $\($h.Source\)"; gh --version } else { "gh: NAO ENCONTRADO" })

PowerShell(git config --global user.name; git config --global user.email; "--- ssh keys ---"; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh"\) { Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name } else { "sem pasta .ssh" })

PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe", "${env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)}\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Microsoft\\WinGet\\Links\\gh.exe"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { "ACHEI: $p" } })

PowerShell($p = \(Get-Location\).Path; "Caminho atual: $\($p.Length\) caracteres"; "Limite classico do Windows \(MAX_PATH\): 260"; "Sobra para arquivos internos: $\(260 - $p.Length\) caracteres"; "--- LongPathsEnabled no registro ---"; \(Get-ItemProperty "HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\FileSystem" -Name LongPathsEnabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).LongPathsEnabled)

PowerShell($src = \(Get-Location\).Path; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "C:\\dev" | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path $src -Destination "C:\\dev\\nfse-gateway" -Recurse -Force; "--- copiado ---"; Get-ChildItem "C:\\dev\\nfse-gateway" -Recurse -File -Force | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace\("C:\\dev\\nfse-gateway\\",""\) })
